name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>. '_39' is the per-event dispatch-table index (0x39) -- a domain ID, not an address residue (function is at 0x354DD, table entry at 0x51C75; neither equals 0x39). '__ch26' is a meaningful chapter ID (1-30 range). '_cinematic' is the verified category. Name accurately reflects purpose and logic.
purpose: Chapter 26 establishing-shot cinematic event handler: loads a turn-indexed portrait set, pans the camera/window to (9,0), and holds 400ms. No dialog.
logic_summary: Stack-check prologue (__CHK, frame 0xC). Calls fd2_load_chapter_portraits_and_dump_tmp(data_fd2_battle_turn_counter) using the RAW turn counter (same convention as ch24 handler_36, NOT the signed /2 used by ch21/ch22 handlers; the portrait set rotates per turn). Pushes pan args Y=0, X=9 then JMPs to the Class-3 shared tail at 0x353C4 (hosted in fd2_chapter_event_handler_36__ch24_cinematic, body 0x3535D-0x353CB): CALL fd2_pan_cursor_and_window; ADD ESP,8; PUSH 0x190; CALL fd2_delay_ms; ADD ESP,4; RET. Source renders the functionally-exact equivalent: portrait load + one pan + 400ms hold. event_arg is unread.
